caption: The drawing depicts a cornucopia, or horn of plenty, predominantly colored in shades of yellow, orange, and red, spilling over with an assortment of fruits and foliage. The cornucopia curves prominently across the image, starting from the lower center and winding toward the right. Emerging from its wide opening are a green melon with distinctive striations, clusters of purple and blue grapes, dark red strawberries with green leaves, and other round red fruits. There are green leafy branches with small, delicate leaves interspersed among the fruit, as well as sprays of thin, red-tipped stems radiating upward in the background. Some brown twigs and sprigs extend out to the left and right. The entire composition is set against a brownish, cream-colored background with a slightly mottled, textured look, and is enclosed within a rectangular, black and gold frame.
title: Watercolor: Cornucopia of Fruit
